title: UI Branch
description: A named set of UI items (components, stylesheets) that override those of its parent branch. A branch with a prefix is published at that URL prefix.

rbac_context.description: The branch's context: grants there decide who may see, change, push from or pull it.

name.description: The branch's site-wide unique name. main is reserved for the published branch at the API URLs.

parent.description: The name of the branch this one is based on, or null.

base.description: live: over the parent's current state; pinned: over the parent's state at the branching point. Needs a parent.

branching_point.description: Server-managed: the version of every ancestor when the branch was started or last pulled.

prefix.description: A published branch's URL prefix ("" or /segment/.../), unique; null for a working branch.

conflicts.description: Server-managed: the items a pull could not merge.

pull.description: Write-only: true pulls the parent's changes into the branch.
